# Headscale Gateway for YunoHost

Private HTTPS access to services through Headscale, with DNS and certificate management

**Package version:** 1.4.19~ynh1 · **License:** AGPL-3.0-only

Headscale Gateway provides private HTTPS access to applications and services on
your server or local network through an existing Headscale network. It combines
a VPN node with a reverse proxy, DNS and certificate management, access settings,
configuration profiles and encrypted backups in one web interface.

The YunoHost package integrates administrator access with the portal's single
sign-on and supports multiple instances, upgrades, URL changes, backups and
restoration. It does not open an additional public inbound port.

An existing Headscale coordination server is required. The portal's HTTPS
domain and the private domain used by the Gateway are independent settings.

The shared dashboard highlights the main service domain as a clickable link in
Overview / Status. The administration URL is shown separately; YunoHost SSO
does not itself provide browser connectivity to the private service network.

The original code is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only. Public release resources
provide the corresponding complete server sources and Go dependencies, with
build instructions and checksums. The package preserves third-party notices.

## Repository scope

This repository distributes only the YunoHost package. Development takes place
in the private [Forgejo origin](https://gentedelcondado.es/forgejo/wolfbelmi88/headscale_gateway),
then reaches its private [GitHub mirror](https://github.com/Gente-del-Condado/headscale_gateway).
The public compiler [headscale_gateway_releases](https://github.com/Gente-del-Condado/headscale_gateway_releases/actions)
reads a stable Forgejo release, validates its exact source revision and publishes
this package and its public resources. It never writes back to Forgejo. The `upstream-source` branch contains public source snapshots for releases; it is
not the development branch of this package.

## Install and upgrade

This package is maintained independently for installation from its repository
URL. It is not listed in the official catalog and no catalog inclusion is planned.

```bash
sudo yunohost app install https://github.com/Gente-del-Condado/headscale_gateway_ynh
sudo yunohost app upgrade headscale_gateway --url https://github.com/Gente-del-Condado/headscale_gateway_ynh
```

YunoHost downloads architecture-specific resources and complete corresponding
sources from a public release and verifies their SHA-256 checksums. Sources,
including Go dependencies and build instructions, are installed in
`sources/source.tar.gz`; third-party notices are in `doc/third_party/` in this
repository and `notices/` in the installation. Other platforms use the manual.
